title: Reduce Array Size to The Half
summary: Given an integer array, select a set of integers to remove all their occurrences.
statement: Given an integer array, select a set of integers to remove all their occurrences. Determine the smallest set size needed to eliminate at least half of the array's integers.
constraints: Remove all occurrences of each selected value.
Remove at least half the array using the fewest distinct values.
hints: Sort frequencies descending and accumulate them.
Stop when removed count reaches at least half the array.
For any fixed number of selected values, choosing the largest frequencies maximizes removed elements.
editorial: For any fixed number of selected values, choosing the largest frequencies maximizes removed elements.

tests.explanation: Removing values three and five removes seven of ten elements.
Selecting seven alone removes the entire array.
